outcome: For one exact encrypted Knowledge Artifact Version or recipient-specific key envelope, persist immutable bytes under an exact durable-storage policy, verify retrieval against their qualified content identity before dependent use, and emit environment-bounded evidence without exposing plaintext, keys, credentials, or provider identity as object identity.
scope: Reusable provider-neutral durable storage for immutable encrypted artifact bytes and recipient-envelope bytes: qualified content identity, explicit storage-policy binding, write observation, verified retrieval, typed failure, reissue-safe replacement, confidentiality, evidence, and separately classified infrastructure cost.
exclusions: selecting a storage provider, adapter, endpoint, region, credential, commercial plan, or deployment
making provider identity, locator syntax, or mutable object name part of immutable byte identity
treating a write receipt, digest, locator, or one successful retrieval as perpetual availability or retention proof
placing plaintext, a content-encryption key, envelope plaintext, recipient private keys, or credentials in stored or public protocol material
claiming cross-system atomicity between storage and a consuming protocol
silently selecting retention, availability, redundancy, migration, deletion, or recovery targets for a consumer
rewriting consumer-capability semantics or treating a consumer instantiation as provider realization
knowledge price, seller payment, royalty, licensing, legal title, reputation, publication, release, deployment, or external execution

revision_history.change: Authored the reusable provider-neutral Durable Storage Product Capability against accepted KEP-DST-D1 through KEP-DST-D15 definitions; no adoption, provider selection, ontology, or implementation effect is implied.

challenge_route: Challenge the generic storage outcome through the Knowledge Exchange Protocol product owner, definition interpretation through accepted KEP-DST-D1 through KEP-DST-D15, consumer specialization through the consuming capability owner, and provider realization through a later exact implementation binding and conformance owner.
claim_limit: Authored reusable Product Capability candidate only; not adopted, consumer-instantiated, ontology-bound, DomainSpec-authored, provider-selected, implemented, conformant, deployed, published, or externally effective.
